name: Secret
short_desc: Share notes and files end-to-end encrypted, through links that open once.
author: largerio
description: Share a password, a note or files through a link that opens once. Everything is encrypted in the browser, and the key stays in the link's fragment, so the server never sees the content. Burn after reading or after a set number of reads, expiry from 5 minutes to 30 days, an optional password, up to 10 files per note.
